profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit, publicly traded company (ticker: DBX) founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools, and its own site describes the platform as offering secure storage, synced team folders, and previews for more than 175 file types. The site also highlights Dash, a product positioned to help users organize company content in one place.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which encompasses document summaries, team data handling, and sharing controls. The company's site notes that Dropbox connects with external AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without requiring users to switch tools, with built-in AI summaries described as coming soon. An MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, enables searching, browsing, and reading Dropbox files and finding documents by name or content.

Dropbox reported revenue of $2,521,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as disclosed in its most recent 10-K filing. The company holds SEC CIK number 0001467623. No litigation facts are recorded in the available data.
